title: cybele laurina
intro: Cybele laurina, commonly known as May Apple, is a perennial plant native to North America. The health benefits of Cybele laurina include its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, making it a potential treatment for cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Cybele laurina include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
